game.name: Band Hero (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Band Hero on Xbox 360 is part of the great Activision Hero series. Even if the title is oriented towards a wider and more family-oriented use, with a soundtrack that is much more pop than rock, the concept remains the same as in the previous opuses, namely to play songs thanks to the accessories offered (guitar, microphone and drums). Moreover, the software can be played by up to four people locally and up to eight online.
